text: An agent runtime executes a loop: the model may call tools, the runtime runs those tools, and results are fed back until a final answer. Streaming events help UIs show progress. Memory stores keep conversation history across turns.

Retrieval-augmented generation chunks documents, embeds them into vectors, retrieves the nearest neighbors for a query, and conditions the answer on that context. Evaluations often measure hit rate of relevant chunks in top-k results.
An LLM gateway routes requests across providers, enforces rate limits, and records usage. It sits between applications and model APIs so teams can swap vendors without rewriting clients.
